scope: Actual UI button calls and event-driven flow with simulated boss failure, boss victory, and transport completion; not a full combat playthrough.
checkNames:
PASS Play mode: Checks require the already running Play session.
PASS Modal root: Canvas/GameFrame/BossCargoLoadoutUI exists.
PASS Explicit references: Panel, CargoManager, and GameFlowManager are connected.
PASS Pirate preparation state: The current chapter can challenge its boss.
PASS Preparation pauses combat: Opening the modal pauses the current battle.
PASS Battle resume scale: The modal captured a positive battle time scale.
PASS Available-card loading: Two gold cargo and three ship material cargo total 112 t.
PASS Configured capacity: Capacity is initialized to the scene's 300 t setting.
PASS Capacity label and graph: The text and fill amount agree with the selected weights, and the graph has a sprite with Filled rendering.
PASS Three-currency preview: Gold 115,750,700 / Diamond 6,440 / Emerald 660.
PASS Capacity button states: Both load buttons disable when neither cargo fits the remaining capacity.
PASS Capacity enforcement: Invoking a disabled load button still cannot exceed capacity.
PASS Selected-card minus: The selected-card minus button removes one unit.
PASS Selected-card plus: The selected-card plus button adds one unit within capacity.
PASS Selected-card remove: The X button removes the complete cargo type and exposes its empty slot.
PASS Close keeps selection: Closing restores battle time and retains both selected amounts.
PASS Reopen keeps selection: Reopening restores the same selected cargo and preview.
PASS No cargo before boss victory: Preparing a loadout does not put crates on the main ship.
PASS Persistence write: An isolated manager saves a changed amount under a unique QA key.
PASS Persistence restore: A newly activated manager restores both amounts without restoring actual transported cargo.
PASS Over-capacity persistence: A saved 432 t plan is retained without automatic clamping and exposes invalid capacity.
PASS Over-capacity recovery: Explicit removal restores a valid plan while retaining the other selected cargo.
PASS Isolated persistence checks: Temporary managers do not alter the live selected plan.
PASS Invalid saved quantity remains removable: A negative quantity keeps its selected card and X button visible, disables confirmation, and displays a configuration error.
PASS Invalid quantity recovery through X: The actual X button removes the invalid quantity and restores a valid selection without changing the other cargo.
PASS Restored scenario loadout: The original 2 + 3 test selection is restored before simulated boss outcomes.
PASS Confirm starts boss: The footer button closes preparation, resumes time, and enters the boss battle.
PASS Boss failure keeps plan: Simulated boss failure returns to pirate waves and retains the selection without actual cargo.
PASS Transport loads actual main ship: The Sell-entry snapshot contains five cargo units and the active main ship displays five crates.
PASS Transport market initialization: Both transported cargo types have active market entries.
PASS Manifest independent from saved plan: Editing the next selection does not change the in-flight manifest or displayed crates.
PASS Currency manager: A currency manager receives settlement requests.
PASS Three-currency settlement: Simulated transport completion settles the original 2 + 3 manifest in all three currencies.
PASS Actual currency balances: The settlement requests are applied to all three live currency balances.
PASS Settlement clears only actual cargo: The manifest and crates clear while the changed next-trip selection remains intact.
